component.name: xx-weather
component.summary: ZIP-code weather from the National Weather Service

description.p: Linux phone port of the PiercingXX Android xx-weather app. ZIP in, forecast out: current conditions, 24-hour strip, 10-day outlook and optional rain/freeze alerts from api.weather.gov (US only, no location tracking), enriched by Open-Meteo. Works offline from the last-good cache with an honest updated stamp.
